title: Enterprise deploy request prioritization ledger and comm scripts for Private/VPC/on‑prem
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Create a lightweight, repeatable prioritization ledger and a set of standardized customer communication scripts to triage incoming enterprise Private/VPC/on‑prem requests that involve complex networking, upgrade scheduling, or air‑gapped constraints. Goal is to reduce subjective routing to Eng/SEs, speed time-to-first-response, and surface clear remediation lanes for customers and CSMs.

Background: Current intake is decentralized: sales and CSMs open requests with varying levels of detail; eng and solutions teams triage manually which causes variable SLAs, duplicated discovery work, and customer confusion about next steps. Existing playbooks focus on gating and risk checklists, but we lack a single ledger that ranks requests quantitatively and automatically emits a recommended comm path and a runbook template.

Scope: 1) Define a prioritized ledger schema (signals, weights, risk buckets) tuned for networking+airgap+upgrade constraints. 2) Build a one‑page triage template and three comm scripts (initial intake, remediation ask, gate/fallback) for CSM/Sales to use. 3) Deliver an engineering intake form and an ops handoff checklist that maps ledger score to action lanes (self‑serve docs, SE followup, prioritized fastlane).

Out of scope: Automated SLA enforcement, backend automation integrations (will be a follow‑up), deep audit log export for compliance (separate workstream).

Success metrics: median time to first substantive customer update reduced from 4 business days to 1 business day; fraction of requests with complete intake metadata increases to >= 80%; time spent by Eng/SE on discovery reduced by 30% per request.
updates: 2026-02-20: Created initial ticket after weekly enterprise intake retrospective. Documented observed gaps and outlined proposed deliverables.

2026-02-24: Sync with Solutions Engineering (Riley Chen) — validated initial signal list and feasibility of a 3-tier action lane (docs, SE follow, fastlane). Riley volunteered to help prototype the intake form.
2026-02-28: Sales enablement reviewed draft comm scripts; asked to add a low-risk 'postpone' script for customers constrained by internal windows. Incorporated feedback.

2026-03-02: Engineering scoping session (infra + runtime) — Eng identified two mandatory flags: 'customer-network-topology' and 'allowed-ips-list' that must be present for any fastlane routing. Risk: collecting these fields for airgapped customers may require manual coordination with CSMs.
2026-03-03: Draft ledger weights proposed and shared with PM circle for review. Next: build a one‑page triage template and trial with two in-flight customers this sprint.
decision_log: Decision 1 (2026-02-24): Use a numeric ledger (0-100) combining: impact (prod-critical), network-complexity, upgrade-window-flexibility, data-sensitivity, and contract-tier. Weighting: impact 30%, network 25%, upgrade 20%, data 15%, tier 10%.

Decision 2 (2026-02-28): Three action lanes: 0-39 = 'Self-serve / Docs + CSM triage', 40-69 = 'SE follow-up (1-week SLA)', 70-100 = 'Fastlane — prioritize with dedicated runbook and weekly cross-functional sync'.

Decision 3 (2026-03-02): For air‑gapped requests, require explicit network topology diagram and approved maintenance window before qualifying for fastlane. Otherwise they default to SE follow-up until artifacts provided.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger schema and sample scoring spreadsheet reviewed and approved by Solutions Engineering and Infra PMs.
Three templated customer comm scripts (initial intake, data/infra ask, schedule-confirmation) written and accepted by Sales Enablement.
Intake form prototype completed in Confluence/Forms and tested on two live requests with feedback captured.
Handoff checklist created with two mandatory engineering flags (network-topology, allowed-ips) and a defined owner for each action lane.
Playbook doc published to internal docs and linked from the request intake surface; basic analytics sink created to measure time-to-first-response metric.
links: Slack thread: #pm-private-deploys — discussion on ledger weights
next_steps: Finalize ledger weights with Security and Sales by 2026-03-05.
Produce the one‑page triage template and publish as Confluence template by 2026-03-10.
Run pilot on two customers: Cust-A (airgapped, upgrade window Q2) and Cust-B (VPC, minor networking) and collect outcome metrics by 2026-03-24.
Schedule training session with CSM and Sales Enablement for comm scripts the week of 2026-03-15.
